subject: High tail latency during migration window — request for service credit & trial extension
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan@auroradata.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: High tail latency during migration window — request for service credit & trial extension

Hi Jasmine,

We hit a pretty bad tail-latency spike during our scheduled data migration yesterday (02/07) between 02:10–03:45 PT that impacted our batch inference jobs and resulted in request timeouts for some downstream pipelines. We saw 500-level errors and token timeouts when calling your inference endpoint (model: rdl-mosaic-1.2) — attached are the logs and a short Grafana screenshot that highlights the latency tail.

Concrete ask: can Redwood approve a goodwill credit (we're requesting 50k free generation tokens) and a 30-day trial extension on top of our current committed pilot? This incident materially impacted our migration cutover and increased our operational costs for the week.

Attachments: incident_logs_aurora_20270208.zip (7.9MB), aurora_grafana_excerpt.png (PNG)

Thanks — we appreciate fast help on this.

Evan Park
Site Reliability Lead
Aurora Data
E: evan@auroradata.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High tail latency during migration window — request for service credit & trial extension

Hi Evan — thanks for sending these details and the logs. I'm sorry this interrupted your migration window. We're digging in on our side now.

Quick asks so we can accelerate an offer:
- Can you confirm the list of endpoints and request IDs that returned 5xx / timed out?
- Rough token estimate for the affected calls (or approximate requests/hour during the window).
- Any customer-facing impact (yes/no) and a short note on business impact.

I've looped in Stephanie (account lead) and Marcus (ops/finance) so we can evaluate a credit + trial extension quickly. Once we have the specific request IDs and token estimate we'll propose an exact remediation package.

I'll follow up with a recommended resolution by EOD.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Aurora Data — proposed goodwill offer and messaging (need approval)

Marcus / Steph —

Summary: Aurora Data hit a tail-latency spike during an internal migration on 02/07 (02:10–03:45 PT). They reported ~48k affected generation tokens and ~6 eng hours re-running jobs. They've asked for 50k generation tokens and a 30-day trial extension on their pilot.

My recommendation: approve a 50k token credit (redeemable against hosted generation calls) and a 30-day trial extension. This is a goodwill gesture to preserve the pilot and avoid churn. Cost estimate: 50k generation tokens (approx $200 at our current hosted unit economics) — acceptable as a one-off for a strategic pilot (deal DL-4821).

Suggested outbound message to Aurora (short, apologetic, and actionable):
> Hi Evan — we reviewed the incident and agree this was a service regression affecting your migration. We will issue a 50k token credit and extend your trial by 30 days. Please find the compensation PDF attached with instructions on redeeming the credit. We're also deploying the configuration fix that should prevent this tail-latency pattern; our ops team will share a short postmortem early next week.

Attachments: comp_offer_aurora-20270208.pdf (stub: compensation offer & redemption steps)

Can you sign off? If you want to increase the token amount or add an SLA credit, flag it here.

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan@auroradata.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High tail latency during migration window — request for service credit & trial extension

Hi Evan — thanks again for the quick details and for your patience while we investigated.

Outcome: we've approved a one-time 50,000 generation-token credit which will be automatically applied to your account under deal DL-4821. In addition, we've extended your pilot window by 30 days. Please see the attached compensation PDF for redemption steps and the timeframe.

Operational note: our infra team identified a contention pattern during high concurrent KV cache invalidations that could cause tail spikes for batched generation; a mitigation was deployed last night that should prevent recurrence. Marcus will send a brief postmortem with logs and mitigation notes by Friday.

Attachments: comp_offer_aurora-20270208.pdf

If you'd like us to apply the token credit earlier to a specific project or route, tell us the route name and we'll make it happen. Again, sorry for the disruption — we value Aurora Data as a pilot partner and want to make sure the migration stays on schedule.

Best regards,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
